statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.14 (Erdős–Borwein full-support irrationality, unconditional).** *For every integer $b\ge2$, the sum $\sum_{n\ge1}(b^n-1)^{-1}$ is irrational. This is Erdős’s theorem \[[1](#ref-erdos1948)\]; at base $2$ the sum is the Erdős–Borwein constant. The result concerns full support, not all its infinite subsets.*
